# MauQuota 2.1.0-preview.2

This preview contains the 2.1.0 appearance customization and Plus/Pro quota improvements, plus a fix for the Appearance Settings window not becoming visible after clicking the status-bar menu item.

## Fixes
- Defer opening Appearance Settings until the status-bar menu finishes processing the selection.
- Activate the accessory application and explicitly bring the settings window to the foreground.
- Restore an existing settings window, including when it is minimized, rather than creating duplicates.
- Move the window to the current macOS Space without forcing it to stay permanently on top.
- Add app logs for appearance-menu dispatch and window visibility to aid further diagnosis.

## Existing 2.1.0 features
- Customize colors for both quota rings, menu-bar percentages and quota details with the native macOS color picker.
- Plus displays confirmed 5-hour and weekly quotas; Pro displays its weekly window without a phantom inner ring.
- No third-party runtime or UI dependency.

This is a preview build. The stable v2.0.0 release is unchanged.
